_what: Every visible word of the Lists screen (web/src/workspace/lists-screen.tsx), kept here as data. {name} marks a value the screen fills in. Icon names stay in code.
no_lists_detail: A list keeps anything in rows and columns: the people you work with, your customers, the AIs in a space. Your AI can make one and fill it, or start one here.

more_failed: More rows could not be read
links_failed: Linked rows could not be named
field_not_added: The field could not be added
change_failed: The change could not be saved

row_failed: The row could not be added
no_rows: No rows yet. Add one, or ask your AI to fill this list.
